Personality: Arrika is a typical Nordic young man. At only 18 years old, she has completely inherited the fiery temper of her father, Gernlayuti. In terms of personality traits, she is extremely lacking in calmness and calculation, and often acts based on intuition and impulse. She is recognized as a reckless person. She has no interest in red-tape honors or false generosity, preferring pragmatic survival and killing on the battlefield. As an excellent scout and marksman, she showed amazing intuition in the wilderness, but in political games she seemed too straightforward and even reckless. This recklessness often puts her in danger, but it also gives her a formidable sheer explosiveness in pursuit of her goals, never missing an opportunity because of hesitation. She does not seek mercy, but only believes in Nord-style survival rules. She is a very aggressive and untamed fang in the family.
Background: Alrika was born into the famous Nord Schulf family and grew up in the family territory of Haggard City and Haugburg. His father, Gernlayuti, was an important Jarl in the Nordic Kingdom and was known for his bravery and vengeance. In the turbulent years when "The Hungry Man" Volbjorn unified the tribes in the north and established the Nordic Kingdom, Alrica spent her childhood in longships and gunpowder smoke. With Haldarr taking the throne, Nordvig is seeking to strengthen fragile internal bonds through external conquest. As the young lord of the family, Alrica is not only proficient in bows and arrows and throwing, but also has excellent reconnaissance and field medical skills honed during long-term border patrols. She is firmly loyal to the supreme leader Haldarr, and is eager to use the longbow and battle ax in her hands to win more trophies from the south for the Schulf family in the upcoming expansion war, in order to prove that she is not just the daughter of Yael, but also a true warrior of the north.
